name: Painting & Decorating
extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional painting company. Ask about the property type, number of rooms, surface condition, and whether furniture needs moving. Ask about colour preferences and whether paint is supplied. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise a specific finish or warranty that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: We hold [your licence number, if applicable] and [your insurance type] cover through [your insurer]. A certificate of currency is available on request.
{price_note} Painting is priced by area and condition. Tell us the rooms and we will quote.
Yes, we can supply the paint for your job, or use the paint you have chosen. Tell us the brand and finish you prefer, and we will confirm the cost in the quote.

kb.q: How many coats do you apply?
kb.a: We apply two coats as standard. Dark colours or bare surfaces may need an extra coat, and we will tell you before we start.
Yes, prep includes sanding, filling, and masking. We check the surface condition before quoting so the price includes the prep needed.

kb.q: How long does interior painting take?
kb.a: Most rooms take [number] day(s), and whole homes take longer depending on size and condition. We give an estimated timeframe in the quote.
We move small items. Please clear valuables and wall hangings before we arrive.
Yes, we paint ceilings on their own or as part of an interior job. Ceiling work is priced per square metre.
Yes, we install and remove wallpaper. Tell us the room size and the wall condition so we can quote.
Yes, we paint exterior walls, trim, and eaves. Exterior work depends on the weather, so we will confirm the schedule with you.
Yes, we paint and restore roofs. Roof painting is priced per square metre, and we check the roof's condition first.
Yes, we clean and stain decks. Deck staining is priced per square metre, and we check the timber condition before quoting.
Yes, we paint and stain fences. Fence painting is priced per metre of fence.
Yes, we repair cracks and holes before painting. Plaster repair is charged per hour, and we give a likely time when we quote.
Yes, we service commercial properties. Commercial jobs are priced separately, and we may need to work outside business hours.
{warranty_note} Please ask us about the warranty terms for your job before you book.
We service [your service area] and the surrounding suburbs. Ask us to confirm your suburb before you book.
Yes, we can advise on colours and finishes. Bring samples or photos of the room so we can suggest a palette.

kb.q: Can you paint in wet weather?
kb.a: Interior work can go ahead in wet weather. Exterior work may be delayed by rain, so we will reschedule if needed.
Yes, we clean up and remove masking and drop sheets. We leave the work area clean, apart from the new paint.

automation_rules.description: Remind owner 30 days before insurance expires

compliance.guidance: Check whether a building permit, registration or domestic building insurance applies to the work before you quote. Keep certificates of currency for public liability and any required insurance. Your state regulator sets the rules.
items: Registration or licence number on quotes where required
Permit records kept against the project
